import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pos {
        int row, col;
        Pos(int _row, int _col) {
            row = _row;
            col = _col;
        }
    }

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B2 = new char[12][12];

    static int[][] D1 = new int[12][12];
    static void bfs1(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
            Arrays.fill(D1[i], -1);
        D1[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D1[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][] D2 = new int[12][12];
    static void bfs2(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
            Arrays.fill(D2[i], -1);
        D2[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (D1[cur.row][cur.col] >= 0 && D2[cur.row][cur.col] >= D1[cur.row][cur.col])
                continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] >= 0 && D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1)
                        continue;
                    D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int N;
        int[] bfs_par, bfs_D;
        List<List<Integer>> cap;
        List<List<Integer>> flow;

        MaxFlow(int _N) {
            N = _N;
            cap = new ArrayList<>();
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < _N; i++) {
                cap.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(_N, 0)));
                flow.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(_N, 0)));
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, int _cap) {
            cap.get(u).set(v, cap.get(u).get(v) + _cap);
        }

        int augmenting_path_bfs(int src, int dst, List<Integer> path, int mincap) {
            bfs_par = new int[N];
            bfs_D = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(bfs_D, -1);

            bfs_D[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) {
                    int cfp = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    path.clear();
                    path.add(dst);
                    for (int curv = dst, k = bfs_D[dst] - 1; bfs_par[curv] >= 0; --k) {
                        int prev = bfs_par[curv];
                        cfp = Math.min(cfp, cap.get(prev).get(curv) - flow.get(prev).get(curv));
                        path.add(k, prev);
                        curv = prev;
                    }
                    return cfp;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                    if (bfs_D[v] < 0 && cap.get(cur).get(v) - flow.get(cur).get(v) > mincap) {
                        bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1;
                        bfs_par[v] = cur;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            path.clear();
            return 0;
        }

        int dinic(int s, int t) {
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                flow.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0)));
            }

            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int res = 0;

            while (true) {
                List<Integer> tempPath = new ArrayList<>();
                int cfp = augmenting_path_bfs(s, t, tempPath, 0);
                if (tempPath.isEmpty())
                    break;

                for (int w = 0; w < N; ++w) {
                    if (bfs_D[w] >= 0 && cap.get(w).get(t) - flow.get(w).get(t) > 0) {
                        cfp = cap.get(w).get(t) - flow.get(w).get(t);
                        for (int curv = w, prev = bfs_par[w]; prev >= 0;
                             curv = prev, prev = bfs_par[prev])
                            cfp = Math.min(cfp, cap.get(prev).get(curv) - flow.get(prev).get(curv));
                        flow.get(w).set(t, flow.get(w).get(t) + cfp);
                        flow.get(t).set(w, -flow.get(w).get(t));
                        for (int curv = w, prev = bfs_par[w]; prev >= 0;
                             curv = prev, prev = bfs_par[prev]) {
                            flow.get(prev).set(curv, flow.get(prev).get(curv) + cfp);
                            flow.get(curv).set(prev, -flow.get(prev).get(curv));
                        }
                        res += cfp;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(B1[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B2[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], '#');
        }
        
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B1[r][c] = line.charAt(c - 1);
            }
            B1[r][N + 1] = '#';
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B2[r][c] = line.charAt(c - 1);
            }
            B2[r][N + 1] = '#';
        }

        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = new Pos(0, 0);
        
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B1[r][c])) {
                    if (B1[r][c] > '0')
                        scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (B1[r][c] == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B2[r][c]) && B2[r][c] > '0')
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
            }
        }

        bfs1(z);

        final int SRC = 0;
        final int SINK = scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1;

        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(SINK + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); ++i) {
            mf.add_edge(SRC, i + 1, B1[scientists.get(i).row][scientists.get(i).col] - '0');
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
            mf.add_edge(scientists.size() + j + 1, SINK, B2[capsules.get(j).row][capsules.get(j).col] - '0');
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); ++i) {
            bfs2(scientists.get(i));
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
                if (D2[capsules.get(j).row][capsules.get(j).col] >= 0 && D2[capsules.get(j).row][capsules.get(j).col] <= T)
                    mf.add_edge(i + 1, scientists.size() + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.dinic(SRC, SINK));
    }
}
